altem_guardians.description: Elite colossal knights in gleaming golden full plate armor with winged helmets, enormous ornate shields and halberds, standing in formation before a radiant white citadel.

altem_mages.description: Supreme ancient sorcerers in ornate white and gold robes with tall golden headdresses, floating above the ground, orbs of red, blue, white and green magical energy circling them.

amotep_freezers.description: Elite soldiers in heavy bronze and dark blue armor with crested helmets, firing ornate tube weapons that spray freezing blue frost, enemies' ground covered in ice.

amotep_gunners.description: Elite soldiers in heavy bronze and dark red armor with crested helmets, firing ornate hand cannons that blast red fire, smoke and sparks in the air, a fortress in the background.

catapults.description: A crew of engineers in leather aprons and helmets operating large wooden catapults, one hurling a flaming boulder toward a distant castle wall, ropes and counterweights in the foreground.

fire_golems.description: Hulking golems made of cracked black volcanic rock with molten lava glowing through the cracks, fists burning with flames, walking out of a fiery volcanic landscape.

fire_mages.description: Battle mages in crimson and gold robes with high collars, hurling roaring fireballs from their hands and staffs, embers swirling, scorched battlefield lit in orange.

foresters.description: Hardy woodsmen in green hooded tunics and leather, carrying axes and longbows, moving swiftly along a hidden path through a dense green forest, ferns and mossy trunks around them.

guardian_golems.description: Massive stone golems carved from grey granite, glowing faint blue runes on their chests, broad slab-like arms raised to shield, standing guard before an ancient temple.

herbalists.description: Gentle village healers in simple green and brown robes with satchels, gathering medicinal herbs and flowers in a sunny forest glade, one grinding herbs in a mortar, baskets of leaves and small glowing remedies.

ice_golems.description: Hulking golems made of jagged translucent blue ice, frost crystals on their shoulders, freezing mist rising around them, in a glacial landscape of snow and ice.

ice_mages.description: Battle mages in pale blue and white robes with silver trim, casting beams of freezing frost and shards of ice from crystal-topped staffs, snowflakes swirling in the air.

illusionists.description: Mysterious robed mages in deep purple and violet hooded cloaks, their faces half hidden, conjuring shimmering ghostly mirror images and swirling violet mist from their hands.

northern_monks.description: Monks from a frozen land in thick blue and white fur-lined robes, fighting with wooden staves, their breath frosting in the cold air, snowy pine forest and icy peaks behind them.

peasants.description: Angry medieval peasants in hooded, ragged brown and grey clothes, armed with a pitchfork, a wooden club and a scythe, rough unshaven faces, determined but poorly equipped.

red_cape_monks.description: Bald warrior monks in flowing red capes and orange robes, in martial arts fighting stances, fists wreathed in red fire, a mountain monastery in the background.

savage_monks.description: Wild tribal monks with painted skin, bone necklaces and tattered green and brown wraps, leaping into battle with clawed gauntlets and spears, jungle and smoke behind them.

utem_crossbowmen.description: Disciplined soldiers in steel helmets and blue-and-silver tabards, kneeling and standing in a firing line, aiming heavy crossbows, bolts in quivers at their hips, a fortified wall behind them.

utem_guardsmen.description: Stalwart guards in heavy steel plate armor with blue tabards, standing shoulder to shoulder behind tall rectangular tower shields, long spears lowered, an unbreakable shield wall.

utem_swordsmen.description: Veteran swordsmen in steel breastplates and blue tabards, longswords raised, advancing aggressively into battle with round shields, dust and banners in the background.
